card.name: Drug interaction and metabolism text
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of drug-interaction and metabolism passages, such as linking words (and, of, that, the) before enzyme, transporter or metabolite terms. Also some partial words inside enzyme and chemical names.

modes.label: Linking words before metabolism terms
modes.description: Small words like and, of, that or the, sitting just before an enzyme, oxidation or transporter term.
modes.example: Propranolol appears to inhibit the enzyme systems responsible for the glucuronidation<< and>> oxidation of acetaminophen.

modes.label: Inside enzyme or chemical names
modes.description: A piece of a CYP enzyme number or a chemical name in the middle of a pharmacokinetics passage.

modes.label: Liver wording in warnings
modes.description: The word liver in an adverse reaction sentence about liver failure.
modes.example: Acute<< liver>> failure or decompensated cirrh

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the text.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words and name pieces inside passages about how drugs are broken down and interact.
